The api died because the disk filled up: the `report-export` job started at 03:05:00 and wrote 40 CSV parts of 512 MB each (about 20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports` in under eight minutes, taking `/var/lib/stockroom` to 91% at 03:09:03 and 99% at 03:13:30. The database shares that volume, so at 03:14:00 it failed with "No space left on device", the api aborted its transaction and exited with status 1 at 03:14:06.

It never came back in this log. The proxy reports "upstream api refused connection" every two minutes from 03:16:00 through 03:28 on the last page of the log, which ends at 05:29:57, while web and proxy keep serving 200s. The cache "slow command" warnings run throughout, including before the incident, and look unrelated.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports` and restart the api; to stop a repeat, move the exports off the database's volume or cap what the job writes.

The log's timestamps are all 2026-03-09, not last night, so check that this is the right file for the outage you mean.
